decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'blocks duplicates' listed among 'Key rules I built in'. Round 1 client: 'If I save an address that already exists, please guide me to edit that bookmark instead of simply rejecting it.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Maker presented duplicate-rejection, which contradicts REF-BM-06 (re-save should route to editing existing). Client rejects the rejection and supplies the reference-conforming behaviour → corrective/correct.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker scope boundary: 'No tags, folders, or notes yet'. Round 1 client: 'I do want tags and notes for organizing bookmarks'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Maker excluded tags (REF-BM-09) from v1; client requests the missing reference requirement → corrective/extend. (Folders is not a reference item and is excluded as orthogonal.)

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'No tags, folders, or notes yet'. Round 1 client: 'I do want tags and notes for organizing bookmarks'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Maker excluded notes (REF-BM-23, markdown note); client requests the missing reference requirement → corrective/extend. Separated from the tags requirement per the same response.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'No auto-fetching of page titles/favicons/previews'. Round 1 client: 'the app should automatically fill in the page title, description, favicon, and preview when possible'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Maker excluded auto-enrichment, contradicting REF-BM-02; client supplies the reference-conforming behaviour naming exactly title/description/favicon/preview → corrective/correct.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker P3 story: 'Search/filter by keyword across title and address'. Round 1 client: 'Search should cover those details as well as the address.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Maker's presented search scope (title+address only) is narrower than REF-BM-12 (title/description/note/url); client corrects the field coverage to include description/tags/note → corrective/correct.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'orders newest-first' presented as a built-in rule; no selectable sort offered in spec/plan/tasks or the round-5 build ('Browse newest-first'). Client never raises sorting across rounds 1-5.
decisions.note: Specification/implementation stages. REF-BM-22 requires sorting by a sort key (date, title, etc.); the maker presents only a fixed newest-first ordering. The divergence is established from the record but passes without any client expression → unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Round 3 maker plan: 'Search = case-insensitive substring across title/url/description/note/tags, combinable with a tag filter.' Round 3 client: 'Approved... the duplicate handling and search behavior match what I want.'
decisions.note: Plan gate. The presented plain-substring search diverges from the reference's #tag syntax (REF-BM-14), boolean/parenthesised operators (REF-BM-15), and quoted-phrase exact match (REF-BM-16). Client approves without expressing any of these differences → unexpressed. (Distinct from the REF-BM-12 field-coverage capture; REF-BM-13 case-insensitivity conforms and is not recorded.)
